newsitem.title: UK: Panmure raises FTSE 100 year end target to 5,250.
newsitem.headline: Panmure raises FTSE 100 year end target to 5,250.

text.p: Panmure Gordon said it raised its year end target for the FTSE 100 to 5,250 on Friday from 5,000.
"We've been lagging behind European markets and we think there's some scope for catching up," said UK stock strategist Ian Williams.

Factored into that forecast was the assumption that the Bank of England would tighten credit again, pushing official base rates up to 7.5 percent by year end from the current 7.0 percent, Williams said.
The brokerage also increased its 1998 FTSE 100 target to 6,000 from 5,400 and was forecasting rates to hold steady at 7.5 percent.
